COD.rationale: Content (red at current node) and its organization/access metadata (origin/history_estimate) and a separately listed content attribute (blue) are explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing/origin conditions (command_estimate, inherited_current) are explicitly linked to the same content referents (candidate nodes).

D.rationale: The content at p0/current/n3 is listed separately from an origin/status field (history_estimate), distinguishing content identification from its status/organization.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.
